crossRefs.note: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome…
Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Elah
people.line: Son of Caleb; father of Kenaz

people.name: Iru
people.line: Son of Caleb, brother of Elah and Naam.

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

people.name: Naam
people.line: Son of Caleb, from the tribe of Judah.

translations.web: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
translations.bsb: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
translations.asv: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah; and Kenaz.
